description: 정보통신산업진흥원_패키지SW 부가정보 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 정보통신산업진흥원. 패키지SW부가정보는 SW사업정보저장소(spir. kr)에 등록된 패키지SW 제품 정보(제품이름, 제품장점, 사용환경, 제조사정보, 라이선스, 적용표준 등) 데이터입니다. 데이터는 패키지SW제품의 명칭, 제품의 장점, 제품이 사용되는 주변 환경에 대한 설명, 제품을 제작한 제조사명, 라이센스 취득과 관련... The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
